channel.title: Food and beverage: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New filings from Korean small and mid-cap companies in the food and beverage sector.

item.title: Pulmuone Corporate: Pulmuone Corporate's subsidiary Nasoya Foods U.S.A. decides a 40,000-share rights offering of KRW 53.2bn for working capital.
Samlip: Samlip forecasts 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 3,389.8bn and operating profit of KRW 13.1bn under K-IFRS.
Lotte Wellfood: Lotte Wellfood's Q3 2026 consolidated operating profit was KRW 89.9bn, up 29.7% year on year, on revenue of KRW 1.17tn.
Lotte Chilsung Beverage: Lotte Chilsung Beverage's Q3 2026 consolidated revenue was KRW 1,050.1bn, with operating profit of KRW 57.0bn, down 37.9% year on year.
HanWool & Jeju: Hanwool N Jeju decided on a public offering of 3,599,929 new common shares at a tentative KRW 611 per share to fund operations.
Sempio Foods Company: Sempio Foods filed a merger securities registration statement to issue 4,208,546 common shares totaling KRW 88.6bn.
